description: This file contains integration tests for the Notes functionality within the Apache Fineract project. It tests creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving notes associated with clients, groups, loans, savings accounts, and loan transactions, using the REST API with the RestAssured library.

classes.name: NotesTest
classes.description: Integration test class for testing various notes-related operations (create, retrieve, update, delete) for clients, groups, loans, savings, and loan transactions in the Fineract API.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including REST-assured configurations and helper instances.

methods.name: testCreateClientNote
methods.description: Tests creating a note for a client and verifying its content.

methods.name: testUpdateClientNote
methods.description: Tests updating an existing client note and verifying the update.

methods.name: testDeleteClientNote
methods.description: Tests deleting a client note and ensuring it is no longer retrievable.

methods.name: testCreateGroupNote
methods.description: Tests creating a note for a group and verifying its content.

methods.name: testUpdateGroupNote
methods.description: Tests updating an existing group note and verifying the update.

methods.name: testDeleteGroupNote
methods.description: Tests deleting a group note and ensuring it is no longer retrievable.

methods.name: testCreateLoanNote
methods.description: Tests creating a note for a loan and verifying its content.

methods.name: testCreateSavingsNote
methods.description: Tests creating a note for a savings account and verifying its content.

methods.name: applyForLoanApplication
methods.description: Helper method to create and apply for a loan, including collaterals, for testing.

methods.name: addCollaterals
methods.description: Helper method to add collateral data to a list.

methods.name: collaterals
methods.description: Helper method to create a collateral data map.

methods.name: testUpdateLoanNote
methods.description: Tests updating a loan note content.

methods.name: testDeleteLoanNote
methods.description: Tests deleting a loan note and confirming its removal.

methods.name: testCreateLoanTransactionNote
methods.description: Tests creating a note on a loan transaction (repayment).

methods.name: testUpdateLoanTransactionNote
methods.description: Tests updating a loan transaction note.

methods.name: testDeleteLoanTransactionNote
methods.description: Tests deleting a loan transaction note.
